project.name: dailyvalue
project.productType: AI grocery and retail shopping assistant with cross-store price comparison

typography.scale: Use the Text component variants (heading1-6, largeBold/Regular, mediumBold/Regular, normalBold/Regular, smallBold/Regular) rather than raw font sizes

motion.note: Sparse. Respect prefers-reduced-motion wherever animation is used.

preferredPrimitives: AddButton for primary actions (label + showIcon={false} for non-cart CTAs)
patterns: One folder per component: Component.tsx + Component.module.css
AI chat replies render in a lavender bubble (ChatMessage variant='wide')

must: Style with CSS Modules and the variables in styles/tokens.css
Treat pixel sizes in a spec as the value at a reference width, and build responsively (clamp, max-width, flex/grid)
On phones, reflow data tables into stacked label:value cards rather than cramped columns or horizontal scroll
Keep visible keyboard focus and respect prefers-reduced-motion
avoid: Adding a background colour to a component unless the designer has specified one
Tailwind, shadcn or any second styling system
Decorative gradients, glass effects, and parallel lookalikes of existing components

decisions.decision: Recipes render inside the AI reply's existing lavender bubble, below the reply text, with no background of their own. Download PDF uses AddButton with showIcon={false}, matching the other non-cart CTAs.

evidence.source: designer instruction, recorded in Claude memory
